builds.name: Undertow: two legal axe impacts
builds.summary: Investigate high two Undertow hits with one real pickup output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high two Undertow hits with one real pickup output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Each Q deals 70/120/170/220/270 + 1.0 bonus AD physical and removes 20% armor for four seconds. Pickup reduces the cooldown to 2.5 seconds times the actual cooldown multiplier or refunds it if that time has already passed. It is not an unconditional instant second cast.
